messages:
Taylor: Heads up I cleaned out the fridge and consolidated all the kombucha into one shelf. Left a sticky: "Please put empties in recycling bin A". Also found three mystery jars 
Priya: Mystery jars = lab experiments or Sam's lunch? :eyes: Could you label them 'unknown' before they become science fair entries?
Taylor: Labeled them 'unknown - open at own risk' :) removed one ancient hummus.
Dev: Quick ask  can we have a tiny pantry index on the inside of the cabinet door? Like a 3-line note: whats stocked, where, allergy flags. Saves 2 trips for me each week.
Rowan: Love the index idea. Maybe template: `Shelf A: cereals (may contain nuts) | Shelf B: coffee & creamers (non-dairy left)`
Maya: Also the grinder is squeaking when on low beans. Might be time for a descaling or small service?
Taylor: I can run a cleaning cycle tonight. If it still squeaks, I'll file a support ticket with facilities.
kitchen-bot: Inventory check: oat creamer stock = 2, almond creamer stock = 0, medium beans = 1 bag, cold brew cans = 6. Would you like an automated order for almond creamer? React with :thumbsup: to approve.
Priya: :thumbsup: please order almond creamer.
Dev: Also can we add a small sticky on the bin: "If you bring food with strong smell, put it in sealed container". The tuna ghosted us last month.
Rowan: Agreed. I will print a few polite notes and stick them around.
Maya: Poll for Friday breakfast: cold brew cans or bagel box? React with :coffee: for cold brew or :bagel: for bagels. I'll bring pastries if we lose.
Taylor: Thanks team. Small housekeeping but makes the week nicer. I'll draft the pantry index template and post it here.
